rule: This file is canonical. The three superseded files stay in their handoffs as history; nothing should be read from them.

naming.convention: CSS custom property names are canonical. JSON keys mirror them exactly.

fixed.why: JSON key did not match the CSS var it defines

typeRoles.role: names, prose, nav, buttons, section headings

typeRoles.extra: font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums scoped to the cell, never global

--r-0.use: data cells and table rows — never rounded

--r-c.use: cards, chips, filter pills, table containers

--r-pill.use: display-only pills (archetype, severity) — never on anything sortable or clickable-as-filter

dotSizes.note: NORMALISED from five sizes found in the audit (5/6/8/9/11). sm = dense rails and tables, md = panels, lg = calibration rows. 5px and 9px are retired.

light.note: Own design, not an inversion — elevation rises toward white, accents carry higher chroma.

aliases.resolution: Both legitimately resolve to the same value today. --line is the hairline, --s3 is elevation step 3. KEEP BOTH NAMES — they will diverge the first time a stacked overlay needs to sit above a bordered card. Do not collapse them.
aliases.risk: low, but a developer who inlines the hex will hard-code the collision

aliases.resolution: Same. In light mode elevation rises toward white, so steps 1 and 3 converge at the top. Keep both names; differentiate with --sh, not lightness.

nameCollisions.note: No token name carries two different values across the three source files. The only collision is EXTERNAL: the palette circulated in the design-session briefs is the pre-2026-07-26 set (bg #0a0d12, acc #7dd3a0, positions b39ddb/4dd0b1/f2a65a/6fa8ff/94a0b0). That list is stale in every brief it appears in. This file wins.
nameCollisions.action: Update the standing-context block in future briefs, or drop the hex list from it and point at this file.

roles.--acc: accent 1 — yours / good / on pace / honest / primary action
roles.--down: accent 2 — attention / scarcity / stale / pending / miscalibrated
roles.--up: positive delta, probability values, frozen-prediction marker
roles.--fail: job or recompute failure ONLY — never shares with --live
roles.positions: labels only, deliberately desaturated so they cannot compete with the accents

constraints: Two accents plus semantics. Reserved, never decorative.
Blue/orange is the distinguishing axis. Green/red is never a good/bad axis.
Elevation via lightness steps, not borders. Hairline only where two same-elevation regions abut.
Every colour-carried meaning needs a redundant non-colour cue.
Team colours (32-team map) are used only for identity chips and initials backgrounds, never as a data colour.

density.numberAlignment: numerics right, text left, CI bounds right-align on the closing paren
density.stickyHeaders: required on any table taller than the viewport, applied consistently
density.bars: always paired with the number; always render a faint track so an empty bar is distinguishable from a missing bar
density.gridBudget: every fixed track set must fit its pane at a 924px viewport; no minmax(0,…) on a column that carries text

nullGlyphs.—: no value exists — never computed, or not computable
nullGlyphs.<1%: a real value below the display floor — NOT zero
nullGlyphs.0%: a genuine measured zero — vanishingly rare, and never a substitute for the above
nullGlyphs.not yet: computable in principle, not computable yet from current state (names the missing input)
nullGlyphs.·: RESERVED for 'no meaningful change' in a delta column. NEVER for 'not computed' — see AUDIT NULL-02.
